title: Analog Attachable Response Types
description: JSON Schemas for every response shape a conformant subtool must produce. Each command maps to a named $def; transport errors (non-zero exit, malformed JSON, timeout) are handled by analog-attach and are not modelled here.

CommonResponse.description: Open base type composed into every command response via allOf. ok is the only semantic gate — if ok is false, always show the message field to the user. severity is a display hint for message only. Commands whose response adds no extra fields (update, rename, move, alias, tool-config-set, generate, build, deploy) return this shape directly.

InitResponse.description: Returned by analog-attach init. config_complete reflects whether all required config fields are present and valid after init.

missing_fields.description: Config.field_name values for all required configs that are absent or invalid.

Config.description: Describes a single tool configuration field and its current value. value: null means the field is not yet set; default: null means no schema default exists. A required field with value: null needs a value before the tool is ready.

type.description: Scalar type name or enum descriptor.

default.description: Schema-declared default, or null when no default exists. null is not itself a valid config value — configs are paths, strings, numbers, or enums.

value.description: Currently stored value, or null when not yet set. Sub-tools must pre-populate required configs that have a default so this reflects the live state.

ConfigEnum.description: Restricts a config field to a fixed set of string or number options.

ToolConfigResponse.description: Returned by tool-config-get. Contains all requested config field descriptors.

CreateWorkfileResponse.description: Returned by create-workfile. path is the absolute path to the created workfile.

Device.description: A logical device entry. Multiple entries may share the same key — grouping is the subtool's responsibility.

ValidIdentifier.description: A non-empty string identifying a node by name or alias within its parent scope. Character grammar is tool-defined. A sequence of ValidIdentifiers forms a path resolved left-to-right from root. On the CLI, path segments are space-separated positional arguments (not slash-separated filesystem paths).

NumberType.description: Numeric property (kind: 'number'). subtype is 'int' or 'float'. Render the value as-is; for float show the original precision. When prompting for update, hint the subtype so the user knows whether decimals are accepted.

StringType.description: String property (kind: 'string'). Render the value quoted if it contains spaces or special characters, bare otherwise.

EnumType.description: Enum property (kind: 'enum'). Render the current value; when prompting for update, list all options from the options array. If an option has a display_string, show it alongside the value.

ArrayType.description: Variable-length array, all items the same type (kind: 'array'). Render as a comma-separated list in brackets, e.g. [1, 2, 3]. The items field describes the element type — use it to guide input prompts.

TupleType.description: Fixed-length tuple, each position independently typed (kind: 'tuple'). Render as a comma-separated list in parentheses, e.g. (3.3, 100).

TYPES.description: Discriminated union of node property type descriptors, keyed by the 'kind' field. Exclusively used by the read command (Node properties).

PropertyValue.description: JSON-serializable value whose concrete shape must match the Property's declared TYPES. Recursive — nesting depth follows the structure declared by type.

Property.description: A leaf property (kind: 'property'). Render as 'key = value'.

Node.description: A tree node (kind: 'node'). Reading a node always returns its full subtree. Alias is absent when the active tool does not declare alias support in its manifest.

AddResponse.description: Returned by add. key is the device key of the created node (tool-generated if --key was not supplied). path is the absolute path from root to the created node.

ReadResponse.description: Returned by read. Discriminate via the 'kind' field: 'node' is a Node subtree, 'property' is a single Property.

DeletePreview.description: Returned by delete when --force is absent and the target is a non-leaf node or implicit root. No changes are made; this is a dry-run preview.

paths.description: All paths that would be deleted.

DeleteResponse.description: Returned by delete. Discriminate by presence of 'node_count': present means DeletePreview (dry-run, no changes made — show affected count and paths, confirm with --force); absent means CommonResponse (final result after --force).

Error.description: A validation finding. path is empty for file-level errors. kind discriminates future extended shapes.

path.description: Path to the offending node or property. Empty array means the error applies to the whole file.

ValidationResponse.description: Returned by validate. NOTE: does not have an 'ok' field — validity is determined by whether errors is empty. The subtool always validates the full workfile; analog-attach filters by path when a path argument is given. File-level errors (path: []) always pass through regardless of path filtering.

IntelligenceArg.description: Describes one positional argument accepted by a suggest kind. kind reuses the same kind tokens as completions[].kind.

Intelligence.description: Advertises one suggestion kind the active tool supports.

kind.description: Free-form kind token. Tools may define any kinds they support.

description.description: Agent-friendly description of when this intelligence kind is appropriate to use.

ListIntelligenceResponse.description: Returned by list-intelligence. Presence of list-intelligence in the manifest declares intelligence support.

SuggestResponse.description: Returned by suggest. Only valid for kinds advertised by list-intelligence.
